admitted_condition.balance: each component after separator removal has at most 2n/3 variables
admitted_condition.discovery: deterministic enumeration of separators up to k; OPEN if none

theorem: For fixed k, an assignment-independent recursive balanced-separator plan and its deterministic structured compilation are constructible and independently replayable in n^{O(k)} total work on admitted formulas.
guarantees: one plan and one vtree fixed before value branching
exact SAT decision on admitted formulas
independent replay of restrictions and partitions
strict OPEN on missing separators or budget exhaustion
decisive_limitation: A dense clique-primal dual-Horn formula is solved by C033 but returns OPEN here, so small primal separators are not a universal tractability criterion.
forbidden_promotions: hiding n^{O(k)} behind the word polynomial when k grows with the input
treating a supplied vtree as free
choosing different vtrees after different assignments
inferring cheap construction from small final representation size
promoting a representation-specific lower bound to P!=NP
promoting finite audits to a universal theorem
claim_boundary: Restricted fixed-k symbolic factor construction only; no universal SAT algorithm and no resolution of P versus NP.
